items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: He was at the Metropolitan for a long time, Sammy Stewart's band.

ctx.x: And they had -- they had Rubin Reed Reuben Reeves went away and when he returned, they had banners on all the cars, almost -- not all the cars, but quite a lot of cars up on the South Side, at that time, welcoming Rubin Reed Reuben Reeves back to Chicago. And they had a big display and a lot of bally-hoo about Rubin Reed Reuben Reeves, and when he came back to Chicago he was at the Metropolitan Theater with -- oh, what's that name. You know the band if I thought of it. He was at the Metropolitan for a long time,…
